name: codex-text-control
description: Edit a single continuous Markdown body in Codex and save an authoritative revision when finished.

interface.shortDescription: Edit authoritative context directly and save one immutable revision when finished.
interface.longDescription: Codex Text Control provides a continuous context canvas and immutable revision history. Edit the full Markdown body, including tables, in one editor or target a named AI extension point. Drafts stay local until you finish; the widget then saves an immutable revision, updates the authoritative pointer, and returns a versioned notice to the current Codex conversation.
defaultPrompt: Open the context canvas and edit the current response
